```lean
variable [CommMonoidWithZero α] [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
  [PosMulMono α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : ι → α} {a : α}

theorem HasProd.nonneg [L.NeBot] (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (ha : HasProd f a L) : 0 ≤ a :=
  ge_of_tendsto' ha fun s ↦ s.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i
```
